nodes.label: SecurityReport
nodes.rationale: Aggregates vault health for the UI.

nodes.label: Vault app module
nodes.rationale: Installable Vault password manager module with applicationId com.aistudio.vault.qmxzld.

nodes.label: Encryption at rest
nodes.rationale: Passwords are encrypted before they are written to the database; decryption happens when data is loaded into the domain layer.

nodes.label: Local storage
nodes.rationale: Local-first design with no account sync in this codebase; credentials remain on the phone.

nodes.label: Master unlock
nodes.rationale: PIN pad opens the vault; fingerprint/face unlock when biometrics are available.

nodes.label: Passilius
nodes.rationale: Android password manager focused on local storage, strong encryption, and tactile neumorphic UI; credentials stay on the phone.

nodes.label: Password generator
nodes.rationale: Creates strong passwords with configurable length and character sets; entropy is calculated and stored with each credential.

nodes.label: Security insights
nodes.rationale: Tracks strength signals such as weak and reused entries for a vault security score.

nodes.label: Vault
nodes.rationale: On-device brand name for the Passilius password manager app.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture
nodes.rationale: Layers are data / domain / presentation with use cases and MVI-style ViewModels.
